title: Top Anglers: Super Fishing Big Fight 2
native_title: トップ・アングラーズ ～スーパー・フィッシング・ビッグ・ファイト２～
overview: Top Anglers: Super Fishing Big Fight 2 is a fishing game and a sequel to Super Fishing Big Fight. The main mode is a series of four tournaments, each of which takes place in a different environment and has a specific type of target fish. There is also a free fishing mode where the player can select from each of the locations and choose a target fish, rod type, season, and time of day to freely fish that area.
